title: Kim Jong Un Convenes a Military-Wide Commander Meeting
snippet: The Diplomat in-depth analysis: Kim Jong Un met with division and brigade commanders from the entire Korean People's Army on May 17, marking the first such gathering since Kim took power in late 2011. Estimated 180-250 officers from ground, naval, air, strategic and special operations forces. Kim called for sweeping changes to training system and organizational structure reflecting modern warfare. References to 'modernization' and 'newly define the concept of operations in all spheres' likely reflected lessons from Ukraine and Middle East wars including drones, precision strikes, electronic warfare, and multidomain operations.
tag_reason: 이전 보고서(5/19~20)에서 군사구조개편과 남부국경 강화 지시를 언급했으나, The Diplomat의 심층분석은 (1) '2011년 이래 최초' 전군 지휘관 회의라는 역사적 맥락, (2) 180~250명 참석 규모 추정, (3) 우크라이나·중동전 교훈의 구체적 반영 분석을 새롭게 제공. 이전 보도의 단순 사실 전달과 구별되는 신규 분석 기사.
